title: Dirichlet-Guided Group Forecasting for Alleviating Over-smoothing in Time Series Forecasting
abstract: arXiv:2606.10592v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Time series forecasting often suffers from over-smoothing, especially when future dynamics are multi-modal. Forecasts may follow the coarse trend of the observed future, but fail to preserve sharp changes, oscillations, turning points, and regime transitions that define plausible dynamic evolution. In this work, we revisit over-smoothing from the perspective of latent dynamical mode compression: under partial observation and single-realization supervision, multiple plausible future modes can be weakened, merged, or averaged during forecasting. Based on this view, we propose Dirichlet-Guided Group Forecasting (DGF), a mode-preserving forecasting framework that explicitly models multiple mode-conditioned predictive distributions and uncertainty over their selection probabilities. translated_title: 迪利克雷引导的群体预测：缓解时间序列预测中的过度平滑问题
translated_abstract: 时间序列预测常常受到过度平滑问题的困扰，尤其是当未来动态具有多模态特性时。预测结果可能只遵循观测未来的粗略趋势，但无法保留尖锐变化、振荡、转折点和状态切换等刻画合理动态演化的特征。在这项工作中，我们从潜在动态模式压缩的角度重新审视过度平滑问题：在部分观测和单次实现监督的条件下，多个可能的未来模式可能在预测过程中被削弱、合并或平均。基于这一观点，我们提出了迪利克雷引导的群体预测（DGF），这是一种模式保持的预测框架，它显式地建模多个以模式为条件的预测分布以及模式选择概率上的不确定性。DGF使用迪利克雷引导的分层采样机制和基于奖励的优化，以鼓励生成准确、动态一致的预测结果……
tldr: 提出迪利克雷引导的群体预测（DGF）框架，通过显式建模多个模式条件下的预测分布及其选择概率的不确定性，并借助迪利克雷引导的分层采样与基于奖励的优化，有效缓解时间序列预测中的过度平滑问题。
en_tdlr: Proposes Dirichlet-Guided Group Forecasting (DGF), a mode-preserving framework that explicitly models multiple mode-conditioned predictive distributions and their selection uncertainty via Dirichlet-guided hierarchical sampling and reward-based optimization to alleviate over-smoothing in time series forecasting.
